keyMappings:
# Using Nash Universal Keybinds Standard v0.0.1
unmapAll

map j scrollDown
map k scrollUp
map gg scrollToTop
map G scrollToBottom
map w scrollPageDown
map b scrollPageUp

map H previousTab
map L nextTab

map <c-<> moveTabLeft
map <c->> moveTabRight


map K goBack
map J goForward

map tq removeTab
map tu restoreTab
map tt createTab
map td duplicateTab

map tp togglePinTab
map tm toggleMuteTab



map ? showHelp

map i enterInsertMode
map v enterVisualMode
map gi focusInput
map f LinkHints.activateMode
map F LinkHints.activateModeToOpenInNewTab
map - LinkHints.activateModeToOpenInNewForegroundTab
